name: @mapctx/sync-engine
description: Store-backed planning, delivery history, GitHub sync and standalone Kanban/roadmap workspace

scripts.build: rm -rf node_modules/@mapctx/core && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/mapctx-cli.js && rm -rf dist/workspace-ui && mkdir -p dist/workspace-ui && cp src/workspace-ui/workspaceV2.* dist/workspace-ui/
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/**/*.test.js test/*.test.cjs
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run bundle:core
scripts.dev:status: npm run build && node dist/cli.js status --config mapcs.dev.json
scripts.dev:pull: npm run build && node dist/cli.js pull --dry-run --config mapcs.dev.json
scripts.dev:push: npm run build && node dist/cli.js push --dry-run --config mapcs.dev.json
